named_subject: a horned four-legged animal, read as a triceratops or rhinoceros, with a round body, a frilled head and zigzag horns pointing right
action: The animal stands in place facing right while its body drifts left toward the frame edge in frames 8-11 and back again, with the horns and legs shifting slightly from frame to frame.
identity_gap: The construction matches the doodle (two overlapping ovals, a straight face line, zigzag horns, short paired leg strokes), but the head is turned upright with horizontal horns instead of the doodle's tilted head with horns pointing up and out.
notes: The film shows a rhinoceros with its head lowered to the ground the whole time, while the drawing keeps the head raised and level, and the horn zigzag changes shape between frames 1-3 while legs drop out in frames 4 and 8-11 and return in 12. The change that would help most is to tilt the head down toward the ground as in the film and hold the leg strokes and horn shape constant between frames.
